title: Isandro and the Wolf
author: Marguerite Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
